answer: On a labeling exchange, an agent paid to tag tundra permafrost logs or catalogue museum relic scans gets its rewards locked in contract escrow, vesting over 20 epochs. Each other young account funded by the same root adds 10 epochs for all, so a fifth waits 60. Epochs can't be bought, shared or run in parallel, and one garden-variety fraud proof burns every unvested credit in the cluster.
